sizeAccounting.totalGzipBytes: sum of the 36 already-gzip-compressed frames/*.bin.gz files; gzip level 9; excludes JSON metadata
sizeAccounting.shippedFootprint: The browser benchmark data_gzip_bytes gate is the sum of each shipped data asset compressed individually by the harness, including metadata JSON. It is not the on-disk frame gzip sum above; stats.json itself is included by that harness measurement.

suppressed: MLIT omits values under 10; absent published category values are displayed as missing, not as zero.
centroids: mesh-centre mean by municipality; not an official boundary centroid
